affixesDesc: {c_unique}Whenever you gain {c_important}{u}Stealth{/u}{/c}, you also gain {c_important}Concealment{/c}. Gain {c_random}[25 - 30]%{/c} increased Damage Reduction while {c_important}{u}Stealthed{/u}{/c} and for {c_number}8{/c} seconds after breaking it.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "Deep in the Labyrinth, I found true darkness. The Hidden became my shadow, their attacks sudden and relentless. But I studied them, and found I too can enter the ether." -Moreina's Journals
raw_en.name: Shrouded Gift

affixesDesc: {c_unique}每当你获得{c_important}{u}潜行{/u}{/c}时，还会获得{c_important}隐蔽{/c}。处于{c_important}{u}潜行{/u}{/c}状态以及打破潜行后的 {c_number}8{/c} 秒内，获得 {c_random}[25 - 30]%{/c} 伤害减免。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “在迷宫深处，我找到了真正的黑暗。隐形兽成了我的影子，它们的攻击突然而无情。但我研究了它们，发现我也能进入以太之中。”——莫瑞娜的日记
raw_zh.name: 隐秘之赐

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Death Trap{/c} deals {c_random}[75 - 90]%[x]{/c} increased damage and will rearm itself after activating, once every {c_number}10{/c} seconds.{/c}
raw_en.flavor:
"And so, when the sun dipped behind the hills each night, he knew that Ashen Jack would soon be near. Watching, and waiting."
- Greenslade's Tales, Chapter 2: "Each Long Night"
raw_en.name: Eyes in the Dark

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}索命陷阱{/c}的伤害提高 {c_random}[75 - 90]%[x]{/c}，并且会在触发后自我装填。此效果每 {c_number}10{/c} 秒只能触发一次。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: "于是，当太阳坠入山丘后的每个夜晚，他知道灰白杰克不久就会出现在附近。注视着，等待着。" - 《格林斯莱德的故事》第二章：“每一个漫漫长夜”
raw_zh.name: 暗夜凝望

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Dance of Knives{/c} drops knives from enemies hit. Picking them up grants you {c_number}25{/c} Energy and increases your {c_important}Dance of Knives{/c} damage by {c_random}[25.0 - 30.0]%[x]{/c} for {c_number}5{/c} seconds, stacking up to {c_number}3{/c} times.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "The assassin moved as though in a dance - left, pivot, cut. The guests did not realize they had been split until their screams gurgled through the slits in their necks." - An Account at the Red Feast
raw_en.name: Death's Pavane

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}利刃之舞{/c}会从命中的敌人身上掉落飞刀。拾取这些飞刀可为你提供 {c_number}25{/c} 点能量，并使你的{c_important}利刃之舞{/c}伤害提高 {c_random}[25.0 - 30.0]%[x]{/c}，持续 {c_number}5{/c} 秒，最多叠加 {c_number}3{/c} 次。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “刺客的行动犹如舞蹈——左移、转身、切割。宾客们直到喉间传来血沫翻涌之声，才意识到自己的喉咙已被划开。”——《血红盛宴实录》
raw_zh.name: 死亡帕凡舞

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Your {c_important}Conjurations{/c} periodically unleash {c_important}Frost Nova{/c}. Enemies affected by {c_important}Frost Nova{/c} take {c_random}[20 - 30]%[x]{/c} increased damage from you.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: The mad artisan saw his fingers turn black from frostbite as he worked the cloth, but refused to stay the needle and thread for even a moment.
raw_en.name: Iceheart Brais

affixesDesc: {c_unique}你的{c_important}召唤魔法{/c}会周期性释放{c_important}寒霜新星{/c}。受到{c_important}寒霜新星{/c}影响的敌人受到来自你的伤害提高 {c_random}[20 - 30]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 这个疯狂的工匠在处理布料时，看到自己的手指因为冻伤而发黑，而他拒绝放下手中的针线，哪怕只是一小会儿。
raw_zh.name: 冰心长裤

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Casting {c_important}Chain Lightning{/c} has a {c_number}50%{/c} chance to activate {c_number}1{/c} to {c_random}[2 - 5]{/c} additional times.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "Do not confuse your manipulation of lightning as control. The azure flame is its own master and needs no hand to wield it. You are merely a conduit for its chaos." -Ascribed to the mage Woh
raw_en.name: Axial Conduit

affixesDesc: {c_unique}施放{c_important}连锁闪电{/c}有 {c_number}50%{/c} 几率额外弹跳 {c_number}1{/c} 到 {c_random}[2 - 5]{/c} 次。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “别把你运用闪电的能力看成是对它的掌控。那蔚蓝的火焰拥有自己的意志，岂是人力所能玩弄？要记住，你不过是它释放狂暴之力的一个导体而已。”——此言据说是出自法师沃尔
raw_zh.name: 枢轴导体

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}While moving, you gain {c_random}[25 - 30]%{/c} Dodge Chance and Damage Reduction.

After standing still for {c_number}2{/c} seconds, you become {c_important}{u}Unstoppable{/u}{/c} until you move.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "To commune with spirits, listen to whispers unseen. Root yourself unto the earth and let its pulse still the mind. Hear the ancient guardians – they rise to aid you." -Ysevete, the First Spiritborn
raw_en.name: Protection of the Prime

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}移动时，你的躲闪几率和伤害减免提高 {c_random}[25 - 30]%{/c}。

站立不动 {c_number}2{/c} 秒后，你会变得{c_important}{u}不可阻挡{/u}{/c}，直至再次移动。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “与灵体交流时，要聆听看不到的耳语；要将自己扎根于大地，用它的脉搏抚平心灵。用心聆听上古守护者的声音吧，他们会助你一臂之力。”——首位灵巫伊塞薇忒
raw_zh.name: 先灵之佑

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}Your Casts damage Close enemies for {c_random}[125 - 150]%{/c} of your Thorns and also deals {c_number}100%{/c} of this damage as Poisoning over {c_number}3{/c} seconds.

Each time you've retaliated with Thorns, for {c_number}5{/c} seconds the Poisoning damage is increased by {c_number}100%{/c}, up to {c_number}300%{/c}.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "Know the dangers of fang and root. One hides in the leaf, the berry, the still water. The other waits in the bite, the stinger, the wound." - Teachings of Balazan, Verse III
raw_en.name: Balazan's Maxtlatl

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}你施放的技能会对近距敌人造成伤害，相当于你荆棘伤害的 {c_random}[125 - 150]%{/c}，同时会在 {c_number}3{/c} 秒内将该伤害的 {c_number}100%{/c} 作为中毒伤害。

每次你使用荆棘进行反击时，在 {c_number}5{/c} 秒内中毒伤害提高 {c_number}100%{/c}，最多提高 {c_number}300%{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “需知根须与利齿之险。前者藏于叶片、果丛与静水之中；后者则潜于噬咬、蜇刺与伤口之内。”——《巴拉赞的教诲》第三节
raw_zh.name: 巴拉赞的缠腰布

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Wall of Agony{/c} gains the Fallen Army Variant for free and deals {c_random}[20 - 30]%[x]{/c} increased damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor:
In the Sunless Depths, Kabraxis wailed.
No vessel could bare the Imprisoned Lord.
Creation could not sustain the road he traveled, only madness remained.
raw_en.name: Kabraxis' Will

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}苦痛之墙{/c}免费获得堕落大军变体，造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[20 - 30]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor:
卡布拉西斯在无光深渊中哀嚎。
没有容器能承受这位被囚禁的领主。
造物无法忍受他走过的道路，唯有疯狂留存。
raw_zh.name: 卡布拉西斯的意志

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Summon a {c_important}Tortured Wretch{/c} when your Current Life drops below {c_number}55%{/c} of your Maximum Life. Enemies {c_important}Tortured Wretch{/c} attempts to Taunt take {c_random}[10 - 15]%[x]{/c} increased damage and deal {c_random}[10 - 15]%[x]{/c} less damage for {c_number}20{/c} seconds.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "Though unruly, demons are compelled to abide by certain rules. When a pact is forged, whether by force or choice, it must be upheld." -Deckard Cain
raw_en.name: Sashes of the Wretched

affixesDesc: {c_unique}当你的当前生命低于生命上限的 {c_number}55%{/c} 时，召唤一个{c_important}折磨憎灵{/c}。被{c_important}折磨憎灵{/c}试图嘲讽的敌人受到的伤害提高 {c_random}[10 - 15]%[x]{/c}，造成的伤害降低 {c_random}[10 - 15]%[x]{/c}，持续 {c_number}20{/c} 秒。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “纵使恶魔生性桀骜，它们也必须屈从于某些铁律。一旦契约落定，不论是出于强迫还是自愿，都不可违逆。”——迪卡德·凯恩
raw_zh.name: 悲惨者束带

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Casting {c_important}Dark Prison{/c} consumes {c_random}[48 - 27]%{/c} of your Maximum Life to reset its Cooldown. You gain {c_random}[25 - 40]%{/c} Damage Reduction while {c_important}Dark Prison{/c} is active.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "What is more perfect than blood? A single drop can consecrate, empower, or curse. Know this: The most potent form is not blood stolen from others, but given from one's self." -Elias
raw_en.name: Bindings of Attrition

affixesDesc: {c_unique}施放{c_important}暗黑监牢{/c}会消耗相当于生命上限 {c_random}[48 - 27]%{/c} 的生命，以重置其冷却时间。{c_important}暗黑监牢{/c}激活时，你获得 {c_random}[25 - 40]%{/c} 伤害减免。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “试问世间，还有什么能比鲜血更趋近于完美？仅凭一滴，便可赐福、赋能，亦可降下恶咒。你要铭记：至高的伟力从不源于掠夺他人的血液，而是源于你自身的奉献。”——厄莱亚斯
raw_zh.name: 损耗殆尽之缚

affixesDesc: {c_unique}You cannot recover above {c_number}65%{/c} of your Maximum Life but your {c_important}Defensive{/c} Skills deal {c_random}[300 - 400]%[x]{/c} increased damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "The morlu are incredibly resilient. Stories from the Sin War describe them fighting despite heavy wounds." -Book of Adria
raw_en.name: Morlu Fleshward

affixesDesc: {c_unique}你的生命最高只能恢复至生命上限的 {c_number}65%{/c}，但你的{c_important}防御{/c}技能造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[300 - 400]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “魔奴的生命力令人胆寒。原罪之战的典籍中曾记载，哪怕它们身负重创，也能继续疯狂厮杀。”——《艾德莉亚之书》
raw_zh.name: 魔奴血肉结界

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Tornadoes{/c} deal {c_random}[100 - 135]%[x]{/c} increased damage and when expire, they instead seek back toward you.{/c}
raw_en.flavor:
"This weapon is a reminder of the unbridled savagery of our druidic ancestors, the wisdom of which I see more clearly with every day that passes."
- Moreg, Druidic Scholar
raw_en.name: Fleshrender

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}龙卷风{/c}造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[100 - 135]%[x]{/c}，且持续时间结束时会转而向你飞回。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “这件武器警醒着我们，德鲁伊先祖做过的肆意野蛮行径。随着时间流逝, 我越来越清晰地看出其中的智慧。” - 德鲁伊学者莫雷格
raw_zh.name: 血肉撕裂者

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Your {c_important}Golem{/c} will consume one of your {c_important}Skeleton Mages{/c} or {c_important}Skeleton Warriors{/c} every {c_number}8{/c} seconds, healing to full Life and gaining {c_random}[100 - 120]%[x]{/c} increased damage for {c_number}10{/c} seconds.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "Listen, no Skeleton is gonna be my King. Leoric is King. King, so you hear me? Hail to the King!" -Farnham
raw_en.name: Mace of King Leoric

affixesDesc: {c_unique}你的{c_important}傀儡{/c}每 {c_number}8{/c} 秒会消耗你的一名{c_important}骷髅法师{/c}或{c_important}骷髅战士{/c}，将生命值完全恢复并在 {c_number}10{/c} 秒内造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[100 - 120]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “给老子听好了，没有哪具烂骨头配做我的王。李奥瑞克才是真王。真正的王，懂吗？吾王万岁！”——法恩汉
raw_zh.name: 李奥瑞克王的钉锤

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}{c_important}Blessed Hammer{/c} deals {c_random}[80 - 100]%[x]{/c} increased damage.

{c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Up to a {c_number}20%{/c} chance to spawn a base Blessed Hammer on the target hit.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: First in the Swan, the Herald by name. This is the star of morning that shines brightest, which marshals the order of all other celestial bodies.
raw_en.name: Herald's Morningstar

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}{c_important}祝福之锤{/c}造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[80 - 100]%[x]{/c}。

{c_label}幸运一击: {/c}最多有 {c_number}20%{/c} 几率在被击中的目标处生成一个基础祝福之锤。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 天鹅座之首，其名先驱。此乃最耀眼的晨星，统领所有其他天体。
raw_zh.name: 先驱的晨星

affixesDesc: {c_unique}For each Defensive Skill not on your Action Bar, you deal {c_random}[15.0 - 25.0]%[x]{/c} increased damage and gain its associated Enchantment effect.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: Lo, its strike is thunder, its sting a dirge. Those smote are unmade, scattered as chaff before the breath of ancients.
raw_en.name: Orsivane

affixesDesc: {c_unique}每有一个不在你动作条上的防御技能，你造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[15.0 - 25.0]%[x]{/c} 并获得其关联的附魔效果。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 看呐，它的击打如雷霆轰鸣，刺痛如丧钟悲吟。被其击中的敌人尽皆形灭，如同糠秕，散于远古之息前。
raw_zh.name: 奥希凡

raw_en.flavor: "...Tathamet's blackened, smoldering husk spiraled into the lower darkness of reality. From his putrid flesh grew the realms of the Burning Hells." -The Black Book of Lam Esen
raw_en.name: Spine of Tathamet

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}地狱裂隙{/c}造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[100 - 120]%[x]{/c}，并且每第 {c_number}3{/c} 次施放会生成三重裂隙。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “……塔萨迈特那焦黑闷烧的残躯，打着旋坠入了现实最深处的黑暗。而烈焰地狱的重重界域，正是从它那腐败的血肉中孕育而出的。”——《兰姆·艾森的黑暗之书》
raw_zh.name: 塔萨迈特的脊骨

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Upheaval{/c} gains the Iron Burst Variant for free and deals {c_random}[120.0 - 150.0]%[x]{/c} increased damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: The demon prince Ikonoth slew hundreds of the Heavenly Host with this infernal hammer before falling to none other than the Archangel Imperius himself.
raw_en.name: Hellhammer

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}扬石飞沙{/c}免费获得钢铁爆裂变体，并且造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[120.0 - 150.0]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 恶魔王子艾克诺斯就是用这把地狱战锤屠戮了天使军团数百天使，之后便倒在了大天使英普瑞斯的脚下。
raw_zh.name: 地狱锤

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Death Blow{/c} gains all Upgrades for free and deals {c_random}[120.0 - 150.0]%[x]{/c} increased damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: The malformed snake creatures that live in the swamps are not content with simply killing their prey. They seem to take a malicious pleasure from inflicting as much suffering as possible before death.
raw_en.name: Overkill

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}死亡重击{/c}免费获得所有升级，并且造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[120.0 - 150.0]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 生活在沼泽中的畸形蛇类生物并不满足于简单地杀死猎物。它们似乎更喜欢折磨濒死的猎物，以此获得一种饱含恶意的快感。
raw_zh.name: 虐杀

raw_en.flavor: "The Cathedral fled south, leaving sanctums hollow and songs unsung. What was left—stone, silver, and sanctified relics—were claimed and bent to the will of elder root and spirit." -Bryona
raw_en.name: Purified Lightbringer

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}粉碎{/c}会将远距敌人拉向你。此外，{c_important}粉碎{/c}造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[100 - 125]%[x]{/c}。如果目标被拉向你、目标{c_important}{u}不可阻挡{/u}{/c}或者目标为首领敌人时，则该伤害加成提升至 {c_random}[200 - 250]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “圣光教南逃后，过去的圣所里已是空空荡荡，往日的圣歌再也无人传唱。而那些遗世之物——石头、白银，还有圣物——都为新的力量所占据，它们被无情地扭曲，被迫顺从古老根须与灵体的意志。”——布莱欧娜
raw_zh.name: 净化之光明使者

affixesDesc: Lucky Hit: Up to a 40% Chance to Deal +[1,800 - 4,800] Fire Damage
raw_en.flavor: "What plague has befouled, let fire make clean. What agony these good people have suffered, let it settle quietly in the dust." -General Arenton
raw_en.name: The Furnace

raw_en.flavor: "The Primes warred, but not for glory. They did so for the joy of mayhem. How many legions of demons died simply to delight the lords of Hell?" -Tal Rasha
raw_en.name: Scepter of the Three

raw_zh.flavor: “魔神掀起战火，从不是为了狗屁荣耀。他们图的，唯有那纯粹的混乱与愉悦。有多少恶魔军团灰飞烟灭，仅仅是为了博地狱领主们的一笑？”——塔·拉夏
raw_zh.name: 三神教杖锤

affixesDesc: {c_mythic}Enemies afflicted by more Damage over Time than remaining Life are Executed. {/c}
raw_en.flavor: Malthael's last and only gift to mankind - a vow that our suffering shall end.
raw_en.name: Shattered Vow

{c_mythic}当敌人预计受到的持续性伤害高于剩余生命值时，立即将其斩杀。{/c}
raw_zh.charName: 德鲁伊, 野蛮人, 灵巫
raw_zh.flavor: 誓言上说，“我们的苦难终将消弭。”这是马萨伊尔给予人类的唯一恩典。
raw_zh.name: 破碎的誓言

raw_en.flavor: For decades, the spearhead lay encased in resin, warded with runes, and sealed in a block of granite. So feared was the venom infused in its tip, taken from the fang of a great spider, long extinct.
raw_en.name: Arioc's Needle

raw_zh.flavor: 数十年来，这枚矛头封在树脂里，刻上符文，又嵌进花岗岩。矛尖淬的是一头早已灭绝的巨蛛的毒牙，毒得叫人闻风丧胆。

raw_en.flavor: "A relic of an old, forgotten religion lost to time and expansion. The staff retains a faint warmth as if still blessed by the dead god it once served." - Ser Paget's notes from the Tiklan excavation
raw_en.name: Sunstained War-Crozier

affixesDesc: {c_unique}你的{c_important}念力{/c}技能可获得所有升级效果，并使你的{c_important}增威{/c}技能造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[60 - 70]%[x]{/c}，持续 {c_number}8{/c} 秒，最多提高 {c_random}[300 - 350]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “这件遗物来自一个古老的教派。随着时间流逝，这个教派在不断扩张中已走向失落。然而，这根法杖却仍散发着微弱的暖意，仿佛依然附着作古神明的祝福。”——赛尔·帕吉特在提克兰考古时的记述
raw_zh.name: 阳痕战争牧杖

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}Your {c_important}Basic{/c} Skills deal {c_random}[180 - 220]%{/c} increased damage and always use their {c_number}3rd{/c} attack. 

Every {c_number}3rd{/c} cast of a {c_important}Basic{/c} Skill strikes three times.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: To the silent skies, the hunter Etzlek raised his staff and then smote the numen. "Release her!" came his cries as he desecrated the hallowed ground. On the third strike, the spirit answered...
raw_en.name: Sepazontec

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}你的{c_important}基础{/c}技能造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[180 - 220]%{/c}，并且始终使用其第 {c_number}3{/c} 次攻击。

并且每施放第 {c_number}3{/c} 次{c_important}基础{/c}技能都会触发三次打击。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 面对着无声的苍穹，猎手艾茨莱克举起了他的法杖，重重地砸向守护之灵。“放了她！”他一边猛击神圣的土地，一边高声喊道。等砸到第三下时，守护之灵终于做出了回应……
raw_zh.name: 瑟帕佐泰克

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}Your {c_important}Core{/c} Skills are now additionally {c_important}Basic{/c} Skills and free to cast.

When cast at Maximum Vigor, your {c_important}Core{/c} Skills Consume all Vigor to cast at their largest Size, and become guaranteed Critical Strikes, with {c_random}[1.00 - 1.20]%[x]{/c} increased Critical Strike Damage for each point of Vigor spent this way.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "Beyond the world disc doth lie the keeper serpent Kepeleke. Ceaseless the serpent grows, and thus must ever consume his own tail, lest the world be overtaken." - Lintel XII
raw_en.name: Rod of Kepeleke

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}你的{c_important}核心{/c}技能现在也会被视作{c_important}基础{/c}技能，变为免费施放。

如在精力达到上限时施放，则{c_important}核心{/c}技能会消耗所有精力，在其最大效果范围内施放，且必定暴击，每按照这种方式消耗一点精力，暴击伤害就会提高 {c_random}[1.00 - 1.20]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “在这世界之外，盘踞着一条名为科佩莱克的守护巨蟒。它不断成长，变得日益庞大。然而，为免世界遭到祸殃，它最终只得吞掉了自己的尾巴。”——林特尔十二世
raw_zh.name: 科佩莱克之杖

raw_en.flavor:
"Yours is the power to pluck the stars from the heavens with the ease of a child gathering fruit from the bough."
- Unknown
raw_en.name: Ring of Starless Skies

affixesDesc: {c_mythic}消耗主要资源会降低技能的资源消耗，并使你造成的伤害提高 {c_number}10%[x]{/c}，持续 {c_number}3{/c} 秒，最多提高 {c_number}50%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor:
“你拥有从天上摘取星辰的力量，犹如孩童摘取枝条上的果子一样轻松。”
——无名
raw_zh.name: 无星夜空之戒

affixesDesc: {c_unique}After spending {c_number}30{/c} Fury within {c_number}5{/c} seconds, your next non-Channeled {c_important}Core{/c} or {c_important}Weapon Mastery{/c} Skill Cast within {c_number}5{/c} seconds is a guaranteed Critical Strike and deals {c_random}[50 - 60]%[x]{/c} bonus Critical Strike Damage. Excess Fury grants {c_number}1%[x]{/c} additional bonus.{/c}
raw_en.flavor:
"Anger brings strength but clouds the mind. You must learn to focus your fury, direct it with purpose. Keep our sacred duty at the forefront of your mind, always."
- Talic, to Madawc
raw_en.name: Ring of Red Furor

affixesDesc: {c_unique}在 {c_number}5{/c} 秒内消耗 {c_number}30{/c} 点怒气后，你在 {c_number}5{/c} 秒内施放的下一次非引导{c_important}核心{/c}或{c_important}武器精通{/c}技能必定暴击，并额外造成 {c_random}[50 - 60]%[x]{/c} 暴击伤害。超出需求的怒气会额外提供 {c_number}1%[x]{/c} 加成。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor:
“愤怒会带来力量，但也会蒙蔽心智。你必须学会集中你的怒气，有目的地引导它。记住，永远要把我们的神圣使命放在首位。”
——塔里克对马道克的告诫
raw_zh.name: 赤红狂怒之戒

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}{c_important}Rend's{/c} duration is increased by {c_random}[6.0 - 8.0]{/c} seconds and deals {c_random}[60.0 - 80.0]%[x]{/c} increased damage. 

Damaging enemies with your {c_important}Brawling{/c} Skills applies {c_number}1{/c} stack of {c_important}Rend's{/c} Bleed. This can only affect each enemy once every {c_number}0.5{/c} seconds.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "The hunger, it starts so small, like a tickle in the back of your mind. You believe the lie that you still have control until you're so far gone you can't even recognize yourself." -Varyana
raw_en.name: Ring of the Ravenous

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}{c_important}痛割{/c}的持续时间延长 {c_random}[6.0 - 8.0]{/c} 秒，造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[60.0 - 80.0]%[x]{/c}。

使用{c_important}搏斗{/c}技能对敌人造成伤害时，会施加 {c_number}1{/c} 层{c_important}痛割{/c}的流血效果。每个敌人每 {c_number}0.5{/c} 秒只能受到一次此效果。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “饥饿之感，起初微不可察，只在心头隐隐骚动。你心存侥幸，以为自己还未失控，但直到彻底堕落、面目全非之时，才知道这不过是在自欺欺人。”——瓦尔亚纳
raw_zh.name: 恶馋者之戒

affixesDesc: {c_unique}When {c_important}Hurricane{/c} ends or after it lasts {c_number}10{/c} seconds, an explosion occurs dealing {c_random}[75 - 90]%[x]{/c} of the total damage dealt by up to {c_number}40{/c} hits of {c_important}Hurricane{/c}.{/c}
raw_en.flavor:
"By fang, claw, spear, or sword - send the bastards back to the flames from which they crawled! Soak the peat with their blood! For Fiacla-Géar! For Scosglen!"
- Nafain, during the Days of Ash
raw_en.name: Hunter's Zenith

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}飓风{/c}结束时或持续 {c_number}10{/c} 秒后会引发一次爆炸，造成总计最高达 {c_number}40{/c} 次{c_important}飓风{/c}命中伤害的 {c_random}[75 - 90]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “用你们的尖牙、利爪、长矛还有刀剑，把这些从火焰中爬出来的渣滓送回地狱！我们要拿他们的鲜血浇注大地！为了菲亚克拉·盖尔！为了索格伦！” - 纳菲恩在“灰烬之日”如是说
raw_zh.name: 猎手的巅峰

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Storm{/c} Skills that you Cast grant {c_number}1{/c} Spirit and deal {c_random}[25 - 35]%[x]{/c} bonus damage. These bonuses are doubled when damaging a {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c}, Immobilized or Slowed enemy.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "I saw her climb to the peak of the mountains. She played a song on her talharpa, so sad it made the sky darken and rumble with thunder." -A History of Scosglen, Chapter IV
raw_en.name: Dirge of Airidah

affixesDesc: {c_unique}你施放的{c_important}风暴{/c}技能会产生 {c_number}1{/c} 点灵力并造成 {c_random}[25 - 35]%[x]{/c} 额外伤害。当对{c_important}{u}易伤{/u}{/c}、被定身或被减速的敌人造成伤害时，这些加成翻倍。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “我望着她攀上群山之巅。她抚弄着马尾竖琴，奏响了一曲哀歌，那曲调凄绝透骨，引得苍穹色变，雷霆悲鸣。”——《索格伦的历史》第四章
raw_zh.name: 艾蕊达哀歌

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Casting or Channeling a {c_important}Human{/c} Skill has a {c_number}15%{/c} chance to trigger an additional equipped non-{c_important}Ultimate{/c} {c_important}Human{/c} Skill. {c_important}Human{/c} Skills deal {c_random}[40 - 50]%[x]{/c} bonus damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor:
"Do not speak to nature. Listen to it. Learn from it. That is the only true path of knowledge."
-Code of the Scéal Fada
raw_en.name: Greenwalker's Signet

affixesDesc: {c_unique}施放或引导{c_important}人类{/c}技能时，有 {c_number}15%{/c} 几率触发一个额外装备的非{c_important}终极{/c}{c_important}人类{/c}技能。{c_important}人类{/c}技能造成 {c_random}[40 - 50]%[x]{/c} 额外伤害。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor:
“切勿对大自然发号施令。去倾听她，去向她学习。这才是通往真知的唯一坦途。”
——《赛尔法达》的准则
raw_zh.name: 绿行者的玺戒

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Your {c_important}Earth{/c} Skills deal {c_random}[40 - 50]%[x]{/c} bonus Critical Strike damage. This bonus is increased to {c_random}[80 - 100]%[x]{/c} with at least {c_number}4{/c} stacks of {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c}. You passively gain {c_number}2{/c} stacks of {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c} every {c_number}10{/c} seconds.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "The runestones in Scosglen are fascinating. Some act as wards, but others are conduits. They tap into the deepest power of the earth itself." -Donan
raw_en.name: Fractured Runestone

affixesDesc: {c_unique}你的{c_important}大地{/c}技能造成的暴击伤害提高 {c_random}[40 - 50]%[x]{/c}。当你至少拥有 {c_number}4{/c} 层{c_important}{u}压制{/u}{/c}时，该加成提高至 {c_random}[80 - 100]%[x]{/c}。你每 {c_number}10{/c} 秒被动的获得 {c_number}2{/c} 层{c_important}{u}压制{/u}{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “索格伦的符文石实在令人着迷。有些化作了庇护的结界，有些则成了能量的枢纽。它们直接汲取着这片大地最深邃的伟力。”——多南
raw_zh.name: 破碎的符文石

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}Your {c_important}Companion{/c} Skills each gain {c_number}1{/c} additional companions and deal {c_random}[40 - 50]%[x]{/c} bonus damage.

Gain the Passive Effect of {c_important}Ravens{/c}, {c_important}Wolves{/c} and {c_important}Poison Creeper{/c} for free.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: You do not see your reflection on the ring's polished surface. Instead, you see other forms: creatures of fur and feather, of fang and claw.
raw_en.name: Accord of the Wilds

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}你的{c_important}同伴{/c}技能可以额外召唤出 {c_number}1{/c} 个同伴，且造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[40 - 50]%[x]{/c}。

同时免费获得{c_important}渡鸦{/c}、{c_important}群狼{/c}和{c_important}剧毒藤蔓{/c}技能的被动效果。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 你无法在这枚戒指光洁的表面看到自己的倒影。取而代之的是其他形态：身披皮毛、羽翼，生有尖牙与利爪的生物。
raw_zh.name: 荒野协议

raw_en.flavor: "The tales spoke of a one-eyed wolf, a creature so cunning that it outsmarted the greatest trappers in the world. It makes you wonder if it was a wolf at all." -A History of Scosglen, Chapter IX
raw_en.name: Mark of the Old Wolf

raw_zh.flavor: “传说曾有一只独眼巨狼，它狡黠无比，竟将世上最顶尖的捕兽人玩弄于股掌之间。这不禁让人怀疑，它究竟还是不是一头狼。”——《索格伦的历史》第九章
raw_zh.name: 老狼的印记

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}When you Shapeshift into either Werewolf or Werebear form, you gain {c_important}{u}Berserking{/u}{/c} for {c_random}[6 - 8]{/c} seconds. Additionally, {c_important}{u}Berserking{/u}{/c} grants {c_number}1{/c} stack of {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c} every {c_number}1{/c} second while active.

{c_important}{u}Berserking's{/u}{/c} damage bonus is increased by {c_number}10%[+]{/c}.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: The ring pulses with primal power, but its design is delicate. Perhaps its main purpose is to remind the wearer that they are still human.
raw_en.name: Fury of the Wilds

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}当你变身为狼人或熊人形态时，获得{c_important}{u}狂暴{/u}{/c}，持续 {c_random}[6 - 8]{/c} 秒。此外，{c_important}{u}狂暴{/u}{/c}激活时每 {c_number}1{/c} 秒提供 {c_number}1{/c} 层{c_important}{u}残暴{/u}{/c}。

{c_important}{u}狂暴的{/u}{/c}伤害加成提高 {c_number}10%[+]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 这枚戒指跳动着原始的力量，设计却十分精巧。或许它的初衷是提醒佩戴者：你终究仍是凡人。
raw_zh.name: 荒野之怒

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Gain {c_random}[7.0 - 9.0]%[x]{/c} bonus Werebear damage for each stack of {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c} while in Werebear form. Additionally, you automatically gain {c_number}1{/c} stack of {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c} every {c_number}1{/c} seconds while in Werebear form.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "To speak the tongue of a beast is more than just trading words. It changes how you see the world. It changes how you know fear, strength, and tenacity." -Greenwalker Ciórdan
raw_en.name: Might of the Ursine

affixesDesc: {c_unique}处于熊人形态时，每有一层{c_important}{u}决断{/u}{/c}，熊人伤害提高 {c_random}[7.0 - 9.0]%[x]{/c}。此外，处于熊人形态时，每 {c_number}1{/c} 秒自动获得 {c_number}1{/c} 层{c_important}{u}决断{/u}{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “驾驭野兽之语，绝非字句互译那般浅薄。它会重塑你凝视世界的眼眸，颠覆你对恐惧、蛮力与坚韧的全部认知。”——绿行者西奥丹
raw_zh.name: 巨熊伟力

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_number}Storm Strike{/c} chains to twice as many targets and gains {c_random}[30 - 45]%[x]{/c} bonus damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor:
"When I was born, I breathed in the wind and the storm and they gave me life. When I die, I will breath out, and return that gift to the skies."
- Journal excerpt
raw_en.name: Airidah's Inexorable Will

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_number}风暴打击{/c}能够传导至两倍数量的目标，并获得 {c_random}[30 - 45]%[x]{/c} 额外伤害。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor:
“降生之时，我将风暴吸入喉咙，是它赋予我生命。将死之时，我将它吐出胸膛，让这份恩赐回归天际。”
——日志节选
raw_zh.name: 艾蕊达的无羁意志

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}Casts of {c_important}Landslide{/c} leave behind Tectonic Spikes that deal {c_random}[375 - 525]{/c} Physical damage over {c_number}2{/c} seconds.

Spawning a {c_important}Landslide{/c} pillar within Tectonic Spikes has a {c_random}[50 - 60]%{/c} chance to spawn two instead.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: When Arreat was sundered, the world quaked. The Druid Aglainn journeyed far to chronicle the aftermath. Grief-stricken by the great mountain king's fall, he rent the earth anew.
raw_en.name: Earthbreaker

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}施放{c_important}山崩{/c}会留下地质尖刺，在 {c_number}2{/c} 秒内造成 {c_random}[375 - 525]{/c} 点物理伤害。

在地质尖刺中召唤{c_important}山崩{/c}土柱时，有 {c_random}[50 - 60]%{/c} 几率召唤出两根土柱。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 亚瑞特支离破碎之时，整个世界为之颤抖。德鲁伊阿格兰远道而来，记录下了这一切。伟大的山之王的陨落让他悲痛欲绝，他再次撕裂了大地。
raw_zh.name: 裂地者

affixesDesc: {c_unique}While {c_important}Cataclysm{/c} is active, you gain unlimited Spirit and deal {c_random}[45 - 60]%[x]{/c} increased damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: A singed wedding band, faintly crackling. It evokes an old rhyme where a bride receives a ring from her beloved, causing them to be struck thrice by lightning. Only the bride was unscathed.
raw_en.name: Mjölnic Ryng

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}浩劫{/c}激活时，你获得无限灵力，且造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[45 - 60]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 一枚遍布焦痕的结婚戒指，隐约能听到噼啪声响从中传来。一看到它，便不免让人想起一首古老的歌谣，说有位新娘从心上人那里收到一枚戒指，结果这对苦命人却三次遭到雷击。而更令人称奇的是，只有新娘一人毫发未损。
raw_zh.name: 雷神之戒

affixesDesc: {c_unique}If a {c_important}Core{/c} Skill hits {c_number}4{/c} or more enemies, {c_random}[50 - 60]%{/c} of the Resource cost is refunded.{/c}
raw_en.flavor:
"Every tome, every scroll, every book in this temple produces the same answer. The only being willing to stand against the Eternal Conflict, against the Prime Evils, was Lilith."
- Elias
raw_en.name: Mother's Embrace

affixesDesc: {c_unique}如果一个{c_important}核心{/c}技能命中 {c_number}4{/c} 个或以上的敌人，返还 {c_random}[50 - 60]%{/c} 消耗的资源。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “每本巨著，每册书卷，神殿中的每一本书都是相同的答案。愿意抵抗永恒之战、反抗魔神的——唯有莉莉丝。” - 厄莱亚斯
raw_zh.name: 圣母的拥抱

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Every {c_number}15{/c} kills in the last {c_random}[50 - 60]{/c} seconds increases your damage by {c_number}2%[x]{/c}, and Attack Speed by {c_number}1%[+]{/c}.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: In the first winters, a desperate spirit awoke within the hearts of men. Where famine walked, the spirit strengthened. When men consumed one another, it found its name.
raw_en.name: Wendigo Brand

affixesDesc: {c_unique}在过去 {c_random}[50 - 60]{/c} 秒内，每消灭 {c_number}15{/c} 名敌人，你造成的伤害提高 {c_number}2%[x]{/c}，攻击速度提高 {c_number}1%[+]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 在太古的初冬，一个绝望的灵体在世人心间苏醒。饥荒蔓延之处，此种精神便愈发壮大。当人们开始互相吞食时，它终于找到了自己的名字。
raw_zh.name: 温迪戈印戒

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Your {c_important}{u}Freeze{/u}{/c} effects cause enemies to permanently take {c_random}[10 - 15]%[x]{/c} increased Cold damage from you for each second they are {c_important}{u}Frozen{/u}{/c}.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: Ksathra's strike roiled the seas, swallowing the land. The sky raged, unleashing devastating storms. In a moment, their empire gone. Their bond forever broken. Her sister, no more.
raw_en.name: Signet of Pelghain

affixesDesc: {c_unique}你的{c_important}{u}冻结{/u}{/c}效果会使敌人永久受到来自你的冰霜伤害提高，敌人被{c_important}{u}冻结{/u}{/c}的时间每经过一秒，提高 {c_random}[10 - 15]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 克思里斯的一击掀起了滔天巨浪，吞没了大地。苍穹震怒，降下毁灭性的风暴。刹那间，他们的帝国土崩瓦解，羁绊永远断裂。她的姐妹，不复存在。
raw_zh.name: 佩尔甘玺戒

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Your Resistances are each equal to your highest, and you deal {c_random}[15 - 25]%[x]{/c} more damage of that Element.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: Nine out of ten appraisers would see a dull stone. Crudely cut. Simply set. But a trained eye might see past the illusion placed by its Ammuit craftsman...and marvel at the wellspring of magic within.
raw_en.name: Stone of Jordan

affixesDesc: {c_unique}你的各项抗性均提高至最高一项抗性的数值，并且你造成的该元素伤害提高 {c_random}[15 - 25]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 十分之九的鉴定师只会看见一颗暗淡的石头：切工粗，镶嵌也简。可练就的眼力或许能看穿安缪特工匠布下的幻象……再为其中奔涌的魔力之源啧啧称奇。
raw_zh.name: 乔丹之石

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Every {c_number}6th{/c} attack from each Minion is empowered, exploding for {c_random}[975 - 1,650]{/c} Physical damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: The signet of Mendeln ul-Diomed, the founder of the Priests of Rathma and the first Necromancer, was lost for over 3,000 years. The immense power over death held within, however, has not diminished.
raw_en.name: Ring of Mendeln

affixesDesc: {c_unique}每个仆从的{c_number}第六次{/c}攻击都会获得强化并产生爆炸，爆炸时造成 {c_random}[975 - 1,650]{/c} 点物理伤害。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 这是孟德恩·乌·狄俄墨得，拉斯玛祭司的创始人和第一位死灵法师所佩戴的徽戒，它曾经遗失了三千多年。然而其中能够驾驭死亡的浩瀚力量并没有任何衰减。
raw_zh.name: 孟德恩之戒

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}Your {c_important}Minions{/c} gain {c_random}[30 - 35]%[+]{/c} Attack Speed and Critical Strike Chance.

When one of your {c_important}Minions{/c} die, your other {c_important}Minions{/c} enrage, dealing {c_random}[30 - 35]%[x]{/c} increased damage for {c_number}3{/c} seconds.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "Can one befriend the dead? What loyalty is earned or granted in the act of reanimation? On this subject, there is much I have yet to understand." -Deckard Cain
raw_en.name: Pact of Bone

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}你的{c_important}仆从{/c}获得 {c_random}[30 - 35]%[+]{/c} 的攻击速度和暴击几率。

当你的一名{c_important}仆从{/c}死亡时，你的其他{c_important}仆从{/c}会被激怒，造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[30 - 35]%[x]{/c}，持续 {c_number}3{/c} 秒。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “人能与死者交友吗？在复生的过程中，能够赢得或赋予什么样的忠诚？关于这个课题，我还有很多不明白的地方。”——迪卡德·凯恩
raw_zh.name: 白骨契约

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Corpse Tendrils{/c} gains the effect of every Upgrade and is automatically triggered once every {c_number}16{/c} seconds. This timer is reduced by {c_random}[1.5 - 2.0]{/c} seconds each second while there are corpses by you.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: The mere proximity of a practitioner of such dark arts can rouse the dead and disturb those souls who have earned their rest.
raw_en.name: Ring of the Sacrilegious Soul

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}亡骸卷须{/c}获得所有升级的效果，并且每 {c_number}16{/c} 秒自动触发一次。当你周围有亡骸时，该计时器每秒缩短 {c_random}[1.5 - 2.0]{/c} 秒。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 仅仅是粗通这种黑暗技艺，就能让人唤醒死者，令那些获得安息的亡魂再不得安宁。
raw_zh.name: 亵渎天性魂戒

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}A dark aura surrounds you, inflicting {c_important}Decrepify{/c} and {c_important}Iron Maiden{/c} on enemies around you and increasing your damage to Close enemies by {c_random}[10.0 - 15.0]%[x]{/c}.

{c_important}Curses{/c} inflicted this way spread to surrounding targets every second.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "I have lost, more than I can put into words. Perhaps there are better ways to express loss than words...." -Rathma
raw_en.name: Omen of Pain

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}一股黑暗气息笼罩在你周围，对周围的敌人施加{c_important}衰老{/c}和{c_important}铁处女{/c}，并使你对近距敌人造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[10.0 - 15.0]%[x]{/c}。

以此方式施加的{c_important}诅咒{/c}每秒扩散至周围的目标。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “我所失去的，远超言语所能表达。也许有比言语更好的方式来表达这种失去……”——拉斯玛
raw_zh.name: 痛苦之兆

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}{c_important}Arbiter's Evade{/c} triggers a random equipped non-Channeled {c_important}Core{/c} Skill for every {c_number}2.0{/c} meters traveled. 

{c_important}Core{/c} Skills deal {c_random}[5 - 15]%[x]{/c} increased damage during {c_important}Arbiter's Evade{/c} and for {c_number}4{/c} seconds after.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "And the moon looked upon the pilgrims and wept a path of light. Through her tears they walked unseen, and night remembered them no more." - Orison XVII: Creed of the Dove
raw_en.name: Argent Veil

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}{c_important}仲裁官的闪避{/c}每移动 {c_number}2.0{/c} 米，会触发一个随机装备的非引导{c_important}核心{/c}技能。

在{c_important}仲裁官的闪避{/c}期间和之后的 {c_number}4{/c} 秒内，{c_important}核心{/c}技能造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[5 - 15]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “月亮俯视朝圣者，为他们洒下泪光之路。踏着她的泪，他们隐于无形，夜色也不再记得他们。”——《祷文·卷十七：白鸽信约》
raw_zh.name: 银月帷幕

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{u}{c_important}Judgement{/c}{/u} deals {c_random}[100 - 150]%[x]{/c} increased damage and has a {c_number}33%{/c} chance to explode twice when using the Judicator Oath.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "So is it written: when the Second Trumpet sounds, the wicked shall fall as stars cast down from their firmament." - Canticle of the Judgement, Verse XII
raw_en.name: Seal of the Second Trumpet

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{u}{c_important}审判{/c}{/u}造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[100 - 150]%[x]{/c}，且在使用审判者誓约时有 {c_number}33%{/c} 几率爆炸两次。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “经文如此记载：当第二号角吹响时，恶人将陨落，如同星辰从苍穹坠下。”——《审判圣歌》第十二节
raw_zh.name: 第二号角之印

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}{c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} {c_important}Holy Bolt{/c} has up to a {c_number}40%{/c} chance to trigger {c_important}Purify{/c}. 

{c_important}Purify{/c} causes enemies to take {c_random}[45 - 55]%[x]{/c} increased damage from you for {c_number}4{/c} seconds.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "No darkness may crown the brow that bears this light. Its radiance shall endure beyond the fall of stars." - Litany of Purity, Verse VII
raw_en.name: Wreath of Auric Laurel

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}{c_label}幸运一击:{/c} {c_important}神圣之击{/c}最多有 {c_number}40%{/c} 几率触发{c_important}净化{/c}。

{c_important}净化{/c}使敌人受到来自你的伤害提高 {c_random}[45 - 55]%[x]{/c}，持续 {c_number}4{/c} 秒。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “凡承载此光者，黑暗永无加冕之时。纵使星辰陨落，其光辉亦将永恒不灭。”——《纯洁祷文》第七章
raw_zh.name: 金辉月桂之环

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Your {c_important}Subterfuge{/c} Skills create a {c_important}Decoy Trap{/c} that Taunts and lures enemies, dealing {c_random}[900 - 1,200]{/c} Corrupting damage over {c_number}6{/c} seconds. This counts as a {c_important}Trap{/c} Skill and only one {c_important}Decoy{/c} can be active at a time. {/c}
raw_en.flavor: The ring shifts and spins on your finger as the forces within desperately attempt to escape.
raw_en.name: Writhing Band of Trickery

affixesDesc: {c_unique}使用{c_important}诡诈{/c}技能会生成一个持续嘲讽和引诱敌人的{c_important}诱饵陷阱{/c}，在 {c_number}6{/c} 秒内造成 {c_random}[900 - 1,200]{/c} 点腐化伤害。此效果被视作{c_important}陷阱{/c}技能，且同一时间只能激活一个{c_important}诱饵陷阱{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 戒指在你的手指上旋转不停，其中的力量想要绝望地逃离禁锢。
raw_zh.name: 诡诈之盘曲指环

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}Gain {c_number}1{/c} {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c} every {c_number}2{/c} seconds as long as no enemies are Close to you.

Your {c_important}Marksman{/c} Skills deal {c_random}[12.0 - 15.0]%[x]{/c} increased damage per stack of {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c}.{/c}
raw_en.flavor:
"This'll blow your hair back." 
- Lyndon
raw_en.name: Scoundrel's Kiss

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}只要近距范围内没有敌人，每 {c_number}2{/c} 秒获得 {c_number}1{/c} 层{c_important}{u}残暴{/u}{/c}。

每拥有一层{c_important}{u}残暴{/u}{/c}，你的{c_important}神射手{/c}技能造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[12.0 - 15.0]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor:
“这东西会让你大吃一惊的。”
——林登
raw_zh.name: 痞子之吻

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}Your {c_important}Grenades{/c} gain {c_number}50%[+]{/c} increased Size and deal {c_random}[75 - 90]%[x]{/c} increased damage.

Enemies damaged by {c_important}Grenade{/c} Skills become either {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} or {c_important}{u}Weakened{/u}{/c} for {c_number}4{/c} seconds.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "The element of surprise is the starting point. In this moment, be sure to finish it." - Kashya
raw_en.name: Saboteur's Signet

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}你的{c_important}手雷{/c}范围扩大 {c_number}50%[+]{/c}，并且造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[75 - 90]%[x]{/c}。

受到{c_important}手雷{/c}技能伤害的敌人会陷入{c_important}{u}易伤{/u}{/c}或{c_important}{u}虚弱{/u}{/c}状态，持续 {c_number}4{/c} 秒。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “惊喜这一元素是起点。在这一刻，一定要把它完成。”——卡夏
raw_zh.name: 破坏者的玺戒

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Smoke Grenade{/c} bounces and detonates a second time. {c_important}Smoke Grenade's{/c} damage is increased by {c_random}[15.0 - 20.0]%[x]{/c} and Duration is increased by {c_random}[7.5 - 10.0]%[x]{/c}.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "Ploughin' told you already! Hidden weapons are out – Yes, especially grenades! Behave yourself, or Morrick will skin you lot."- Purveyor of the Gea Kul fighting pits, on the eve of Morrick's murder
raw_en.name: Pitfighter's Gull

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}烟雾手雷{/c}会反弹并发生第二次爆炸。{c_important}烟雾手雷{/c}的伤害提高 {c_random}[15.0 - 20.0]%[x]{/c}，持续时间延长 {c_random}[7.5 - 10.0]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “早跟你们说过了！这里不让用暗器——没错，特别是手雷！听好了，都给我放规矩点儿。不然的话，莫里克就扒了你们的皮。”——吉·库尔角斗场主办方在莫里克遇害前夜的发言
raw_zh.name: 深坑斗士的诈术

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}Skills that form {c_important}{u}Ice Spikes{/u}{/c} deal {c_random}[80 - 100]%[x]{/c} increased damage. 

{c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Up to a {c_number}15%{/c} chance to form an exploding {c_important}{u}Ice Spike{/u}{/c}, dealing {c_random}225{/c} Cold damage. {/c}
raw_en.flavor:
"Her lover's spirit faded, and in her sorrow she wept frozen tears. Where they fell, roses of the purest ice would blossom each winter."
- Greenslade's Tales, Chapter 7: "The Myth of Irina Coldheart"
raw_en.name: Blue Rose

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}能生成{c_important}{u}冰刺{/u}{/c}的技能造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[80 - 100]%[x]{/c}。

{c_label}幸运一击:{/c} 最多有 {c_number}15%{/c} 几率生成一个爆炸的{c_important}{u}冰刺{/u}{/c}，造成 {c_random}225{/c} 点冰霜伤害。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “她所爱之人的灵魂消散了，她在悲伤之中流下了冻结的泪水。每到冬天，眼泪滴落的地方都会开出纯净的冰玫瑰。” - 《格林斯莱德故事》第七章：“冰心伊丽娜的神话”
raw_zh.name: 蓝玫瑰

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Casting a {c_important}Pyromancy{/c}, {c_important}Shock{/c}, or {c_important}Frost{/c} Skill increases your damage by {c_random}[10.0 - 20.0]%[x]{/c} for {c_number}8{/c} seconds, stacking once per Element. Casting again refreshes all bonuses if the previous skill was a different Element.{/c}
raw_en.flavor:
"Fool said he dug it out of the sands near Lut Gholein with a few other 'worthless trinkets'. I hid my delight at receiving such a treasure in exchange for a meager handful of coins."
- Rakhaan
raw_en.name: Tal Rasha's Iridescent Loop

affixesDesc: {c_unique}施放{c_important}爆焰{/c}、{c_important}电冲{/c}或{c_important}寒霜{/c}技能会使你造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[10.0 - 20.0]%[x]{/c}，持续 {c_number}8{/c} 秒。每种元素法术叠加一层效果。若施放的技能与前一个技能元素类型不同，则会刷新所有加成。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor:
“有个傻瓜说，这东西是他从鲁·高因附近的沙地里连同其他一些‘毫无价值的破烂玩意儿’一起挖出来的。我喜不自胜，但还是装作若无其事，用区区几个金币换来了这件宝物。”
——拉克罕
raw_zh.name: 塔·拉夏的虹彩指环

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}Cast {c_important}Shock{/c} Skill damage leaves enemies Magnetized for {c_number}4{/c} seconds, causing them to emit {u}{c_important}Crackling Energy{/c}{/u} and receive {c_random}[40.0 - 60.0]%[x]{/c} increased {c_important}Shock{/c} damage from you. 

{u}{c_important}Crackling Energy's{/c}{/u} damage Pulls Magnetized enemies together.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "This gem acts as a conduit for aetheric filaments, enabling the wielder to summon atmospheric discharge at will." - Excerpt from Volatus Arcanum: Of Skybinding and Stormcraft
raw_en.name: Galvanic Azurite

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}施放{c_important}电冲{/c}技能造成伤害会使敌人磁化 {c_number}4{/c} 秒，导致其释放{u}{c_important}爆裂电花{/c}{/u}，并且受到来自你的{c_important}电冲{/c}伤害提高 {c_random}[40.0 - 60.0]%[x]{/c}。

{u}{c_important}爆裂电花{/c}{/u}的伤害将磁化的敌人拉拽至一起。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “这块宝石充当着以太纤丝的导体，能够让持有者随心所欲地召唤空气中的电能。”——《水晶奥义：缚天织雷》选段
raw_zh.name: 流电石青

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}Your {c_important}Pyromancy{/c} Critical Strike Damage is increased by {c_random}[60 - 80]%[x]{/c} against {c_important}{u}Healthy{/u}{/c} enemies and your {c_important}Pyromancy{/c} Critical Strike Chance is increased by {c_random}[40 - 60]%[x]{/c} against {c_important}{u}Injured{/u}{/c} enemies.

Killing an enemy with a Critical Strike grants both bonuses against all enemies as well as {c_number}50%[+]{/c} Attack Speed for {c_number}4{/c} seconds.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: Pillaged from the charred remains of Lord Bareen. It still feels hot to the touch.
raw_en.name: Molten Band

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}你对{c_important}{u}健康{/u}{/c}敌人造成的{c_important}爆焰{/c}暴击伤害提高 {c_random}[60 - 80]%[x]{/c}，对{c_important}{u}受伤{/u}{/c}敌人造成的{c_important}爆焰{/c}暴击几率提高 {c_random}[40 - 60]%[x]{/c}。

用暴击消灭一名敌人后，你会对所有敌人同时获得这两种加成，以及 {c_number}50%[+]{/c} 攻击速度，持续 {c_number}4{/c} 秒。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 从芭蕊恩领主烧焦的遗骸中掠夺而来。摸起来仍然感觉很烫。
raw_zh.name: 熔火指环

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Casting {c_important}Pyromancy{/c} Skills Burns you for {c_number}5%{/c} of your Maximum Life over {c_number}10{/c} seconds. You inflict {c_random}[200 - 250]%[x]{/c} increased Burning damage based on how much of your Life is Burning.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: Made from the finger of a silver-haired mage
raw_en.name: Drognan's Anguish

affixesDesc: {c_unique}施放{c_important}爆焰{/c}技能会在 {c_number}10{/c} 秒内使你燃烧，造成相当于你生命上限 {c_number}5%{/c} 的伤害。根据你燃烧的生命值比例，你造成的燃烧伤害提高 {c_random}[200 - 250]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 由一位银发法师的手指制作而成。
raw_zh.name: 卓格楠的苦闷

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Each Damage over Time type you apply explodes every second, dealing {c_random}[450 - 525]{/c} damage over {c_number}4{/c} seconds to surrounding enemies.{/c}
raw_en.charName: Sorcerer, Druid, Barbarian, Rogue, Necromancer, Spiritborn, Warlock
raw_en.flavor: Skulking in the shadows of the Realm of Destruction, the Scarred Baron plots the downfall of the mortal who banished him there.
raw_en.name: X'Fal's Corroded Signet

affixesDesc: {c_unique}你施加的每种持续性伤害类型每秒都会触发一次爆发，在 {c_number}4{/c} 秒内对周围敌人造成 {c_random}[450 - 525]{/c} 点伤害。{/c}
raw_zh.charName: 巫师, 德鲁伊, 野蛮人, 游侠, 死灵法师, 灵巫, 术士
raw_zh.flavor: 疤痕男爵在毁灭界的暗影中潜伏着，密谋毁灭将自己放逐于此的凡人。
raw_zh.name: 埃克斯法的锈蚀玺戒

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Lightning damage against Close enemies has a {c_number}25%{/c} chance to grant {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c} and deal {c_random}[250 - 300]%[x]{/c} increased damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: The Unclean burned the Monastery, and all knowledge within. They beheaded the monks, and kept their tongues. All artifacts were lost - save for this.
raw_en.name: Thundergod's Blessing

affixesDesc: x[6 - 10]% 闪电 伤害增倍
{c_unique}对近距敌人造成闪电伤害有 {c_number}25%{/c} 几率获得 {c_important}{u}决断{/u}{/c}并使造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[250 - 300]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.charName: 巫师, 德鲁伊, 灵巫
raw_zh.flavor: 不洁者焚毁了修道院，以及其中的所有知识。他们斩下了僧侣的首级，并割去了他们的舌头。除了这一件圣物，其余皆已失落。
raw_zh.name: 雷神之赐

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}Every time you deal Thorns damage, you gain {c_random}[7 - 10]{/c} Vigor.

Gain {c_important}Toxic Skin's{/c} Passive Effect.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: The inner curve of this band is lined with thorns that tear the skin whenever it is unbound.
raw_en.name: Wound Drinker

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}当你每次造成荆棘伤害时，获得 {c_random}[7 - 10]{/c} 点精力。

获得{c_important}毒素之肤{/c}的被动效果。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 这个戒指的内侧布满了荆棘，每当解开时都会撕裂皮肤。
raw_zh.name: 饮伤者

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}A {c_important}{u}Pestilent Swarm{/u}{/c} spawns from you every {c_number}4{/c} seconds, dealing {c_random}[188 - 225]{/c} Poison damage per hit. 

Your {c_important}{u}Pestilent Swarms{/u}{/c} now orbit around you and reduce an equipped Eagle Skill's cooldown by {c_number}0.25{/c} seconds per hit.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "Within this corpse-bound carapace we writhe. Chaotic winds converge to churn your bones. Our beat and breath a ceaseless war to break. The wretched cyclone black beyond the bounds." - Balazan's Dream
raw_en.name: Ring of Writhing Moon

affixesDesc: x[6 - 10]% 毒素 伤害增倍

{c_unique}每 {c_number}4{/c} 秒在你的位置生成一个{c_important}{u}染疫虫群{/u}{/c}，每次命中造成 {c_random}[188 - 225]{/c} 点毒素伤害。

你的{c_important}{u}染疫虫群{/u}{/c}现在会围绕在你身边飞旋，每次命中时使装备的天鹰技能冷却时间缩短 {c_number}0.25{/c} 秒。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “我们在这个亡骸造就的躯壳中翻滚挣扎。混沌的狂风汇聚而起，将你的枯骨搅得猎猎作响。我们的心跳和呼吸像一场永无宁日的战争，不知何时才能解脱。而那可怕的旋风一片漆黑，无边无际。”——巴拉赞的梦
raw_zh.name: 扭曲月华之戒

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}Casting {c_important}Evade{/c} consumes {c_number}1{/c} stack of {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c} to increase your damage dealt by {c_random}[50 - 60]%[x]{/c} for {c_number}5{/c} seconds.

Gain {c_important}Armored Hide's{/c} Passive Effect.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: A gentle whisper glides upon the winds. The words elude the grasp of mortal ken. They weave through the soul like a melody forgotten, and from this arises a name: Adarja, the First-Breather.
raw_en.name: Band of First Breath

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}使用{c_important}闪避{/c}会消耗 {c_number}1{/c} 层{c_important}{u}决断{/u}{/c}，使你造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[50 - 60]%[x]{/c}，持续 {c_number}5{/c} 秒。

获得{c_important}披甲厚皮{/c}的被动效果。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 轻柔的低语飘荡在风中，诉说着凡人无法理解的内容。它像是一段被人遗忘的旋律，在灵魂身畔萦绕流动。然后，一个新的存在由此而生，那便是“原初之息”阿达尔贾。
raw_zh.name: 初息指环

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}While you have at least {c_number}4{/c} stacks of {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c}, you gain {c_random}[15 - 20]%[x]{/c} increased damage and {c_random}[60 - 80]%[+]{/c} increased Armor.

Gaining {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c} also grants {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c}.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "In Natsalarwaka, no blood shall mar the earth. Even bitter enemies must forgo their blades before entering the haven. Breaking this accord will invoke Wasipotsu's wrath." - Oral Oaxazi Scripture
raw_en.name: Peacemonger's Signet

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}当你至少拥有 {c_number}4{/c} 层{c_important}{u}残暴{/u}{/c}时，你造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[15 - 20]%[x]{/c}，护甲值提高 {c_random}[60 - 80]%[+]{/c}。

获得{c_important}{u}残暴{/u}{/c}时也会获得{c_important}{u}决断{/u}{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “在纳特萨拉瓦卡，鲜血不得玷污大地。即便是死敌，也必须在踏足这片圣地之前放下刀剑。破坏此协定将会招致瓦西波祖的愤怒。”——口口相传的奥克萨西经文
raw_zh.name: 和平倡导者的玺戒

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}Your Maximum Vigor is increased by {c_number}50%{/c}, and killing an enemy grants you {c_random}[7 - 10]{/c} Vigor. 

While you have {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c}, your new Poisoning effects last {c_number}33%{/c} longer. {/c}
raw_en.flavor: "At midday thundered the first brother, Nyamoyo, lord of predators. Survival is his blessing, hunting is his prayer. Honor him and prowess shall be your reward." - The Nitī Sē, Verse IV
raw_en.name: Ring of the Midday Hunt

affixesDesc: x[6 - 10]% 毒素 伤害增倍

{c_unique}你的精力上限提高 {c_number}50%{/c}。此外，每消灭一名敌人都可以使你获得 {c_random}[7 - 10]{/c} 点精力。

身上带有任何{c_important}{u}残暴{/u}{/c}效果时，你的新中毒效果持续时间延长 {c_number}33%{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “正午时分，尼亚莫约高声狂吼。他是诸兄弟之长，又是掠食者之主。活命是他的恩泽，狩猎是他的祝祷。为他带去殊荣吧，你将因此获得超凡的勇武。”——《尼提·赛》，第四节
raw_zh.name: 正午狩猎之戒

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}When you Critically Strike, you regain {c_random}[40 - 50]%[+]{/c} of the Vigor you've spent in the last {c_number}2{/c} seconds.

Gain {c_important}Counterattack's{/c} Passive Effect.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "At midnight laughed the second brother, Nebahayomo, spirit of cunning. Trickery is his blessing, suffering is his prayer. Honor him and shrewdness shall be your reward." - The Nitī Sē, Verse V
raw_en.name: Ring of the Midnight Sun

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}当你造成暴击时，恢复过去 {c_number}2{/c} 秒内精力消耗的 {c_random}[40 - 50]%[+]{/c}。

获得{c_important}反击{/c}的被动效果。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “午夜时分，涅巴哈尤摩开口大笑。他是诸兄弟之仲，亦是位狡黠之灵。诡诈是他的恩泽，苦难是他的祝祷。为他带去殊荣吧，你将因此获得过人的精明。”——《尼提·赛》，第五节
raw_zh.name: 午夜骄阳之戒

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Rampage{/c} deals {c_random}[200 - 240]%[x]{/c} increased damage. Each enemy or demon killed by {c_important}Rampage{/c} increases the size of the brute and its smashes by {c_number}5%{/c}, up to {c_number}50%{/c}.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "It glows because it is pleased." -Author Unknown, blood used as inscription
raw_en.name: Lurid Pact

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}横冲直撞{/c}造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[200 - 240]%[x]{/c}。每个被{c_important}横冲直撞{/c}消灭的敌人或恶魔都会使恶魔蛮兵的体型及其猛击范围扩大 {c_number}5%{/c}，最多扩大 {c_number}50%{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “它发光是因为它很愉悦。”——佚名，以血为铭
raw_zh.name: 骇人契约

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Infernal Breath{/c} gains the Explosive Death Variant for free and deals {c_random}[120 - 130]%[x]{/c} increased damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "Azmodan has plied the honeyed lures of sin. Where terror and hatred break the soul, temptation bends the faithful knee for use." -Of Primes and Lesser Evils, Volume I
raw_en.name: Sire of Sin

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}冥狱魔息{/c}免费获得死亡爆炸变体，造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[120 - 130]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “阿兹莫丹施展了罪恶的甜蜜诱惑。当恐惧与憎恨击溃灵魂时，诱惑能让虔诚者屈膝臣服，为其所用。”——《魔神与魔王》第一卷
raw_zh.name: 罪恶之父

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Tyrant's Grasp{/c} deals {c_random}[100 - 120]%[x]{/c} increased damage and summons {c_number}5{/c} additional demonic hands in all directions.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "The creatures of Hell are craven, wretched things, clawing at scraps like mongrels. Hells' hundred hands do not fight. They clamber forward like cowards in the dark." -Tal Rasha
raw_en.name: Hecaton Chasm

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}暴君魔掌{/c}造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[100 - 120]%[x]{/c}，并在四周额外召唤 {c_number}5{/c} 只恶魔之手。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “地狱的生物是懦弱、可悲的渣滓，像野狗一样争抢残羹冷炙。地狱的百手从不正面交锋。它们只像黑暗中的懦夫一样匍匐前行。”——塔·拉夏
raw_zh.name: 赫卡顿深渊

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Profane Sentinel{/c} deals {c_random}[230 - 270]%[x]{/c} increased damage and summons an additional eye that follows you for {c_number}10{/c} seconds.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: Upon the seal was graven the Name of the Ophanim. And though they were not demon, their will bent the same.
raw_en.name: Seal of the Ophanim

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}渎神守望{/c}造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[230 - 270]%[x]{/c}，并召唤一个额外的眼球跟随你，持续 {c_number}10{/c} 秒。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 符印上刻有座天使之名。尽管他们并非恶魔，其意志却同样遭到了扭曲。
raw_zh.name: 座天使符印

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Sigil of Summons{/c} deals {c_random}[100 - 140]%[x]{/c} increased damage and you can summon up to {c_number}2{/c} additional Lesser Demons with {c_number}10{/c} kills outside the ritual.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "The apprentice called for one. Two answered. Then the third crawled out afterward, unfinished, screaming like it had been torn free too early." -Master Azevera
raw_en.name: The Fecund Seal

raw_en.name: Hellbrand Signet

raw_zh.flavor: “那个界域的火与我们世界的火截然不同。它似乎拥有生命。并非毫无思想，而是被赋予了目的。仿佛它是流淌在不可名状血管中的血液。”——杰雷·哈拉什
raw_zh.name: 狱印玺戒
